summary: Tested Google OAuth Social Login for AfroVending. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Fixed HTTPException handling bug in auth.py. Frontend: Google Sign-in button visible and functional, redirects correctly to Emergent Auth. Callback route properly handles session_id. Cookie-based authentication working.
passed_tests: GET /api/auth/me works with Google session in Authorization header
GET /api/auth/me works with Google session in Cookie
POST /api/auth/google/logout clears session and returns success
Orders endpoint works with Google session token
Login page shows Google Sign-in button with data-testid
/auth/callback redirects to login on invalid session
User dashboard accessible with valid session cookie
Dashboard displays Google user info correctly

bug_fixed.description: HTTPException was being caught by generic Exception handler and wrapped as 500 error
bug_fixed.fix: Added explicit HTTPException handler before generic Exception to re-raise HTTP exceptions as-is

test_credentials.note: Test sessions are created and cleaned up by pytest. No permanent test credentials created.

seed_data_creation: No seed data required - tests create/delete their own sessions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth Social Login is fully functional. Flow: 1) User clicks 'Sign in with Google' on /login page, 2) Redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com with redirect URL, 3) After Google auth, Emergent redirects to /auth/callback?session_id=xxx, 4) AuthCallback.jsx calls processGoogleCallback() which POSTs to /api/auth/google/session, 5) Backend exchanges session_id for user data, creates/updates user, creates session, returns JWT + sets session_token cookie. Key endpoints: POST /api/auth/google/session, POST /api/auth/google/logout, GET /api/auth/me (supports both JWT and session cookie).

google_oauth_flow.session_processing: POST /api/auth/google/session exchanges session_id for user data
google_oauth_flow.user_creation: New Google users are created with role='customer'
google_oauth_flow.existing_user: Existing users are updated with Google profile info

authentication.session_cookie: session_token cookie set with httpOnly, secure, sameSite=none
authentication.jwt_token: JWT also returned for API compatibility
authentication.auth_me: Supports both session cookie and JWT for /api/auth/me

email_password_login.google_only_blocked: Users without password correctly told to use Google login

api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/auth/me: Returns user profile (supports session cookie + JWT)
api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/orders: Protected endpoint works with Google session
